_comment: Linux. Replace the npx path with yours (`which npx`) and pass env.PATH explicitly — MCP clients spawn servers with a stripped environment, and a missing node makes tools silently never appear; the nvm path below is a common case. ego does NOT ship for Linux yet: the logged-in browser role is filled by Chrome DevTools MCP attached to your daily Chrome or by agent-browser (see docs/SETUP.md Step 2). Cua Driver on Linux is a pre-release (X11 / XWayland + AT-SPI 2); run `cua-driver mcp-config` after installing it and use the exact output it prints.
